Info for Man's Ruin


If 2023’s viral single ‘Toothache’ was the springboard, Westislonely’s new EP ‘Man’s Ruin’ lays the claim for her rockstar power. After a turbulent personal year following 2025’s debut EP ‘Even A Worm Will Turn’, the 21-year-old has swapped Leeds for her Manchester roots and supercharged its follow-up with larger-than-life production and stark, vulnerable lyricism.

“I love the anger of punk, the joy of pop,” West says of her strikingly broad taste: modern visionaries FKA Twigs and Magdalena Bay plus 1960s icons like The Doors and The Velvet Underground. The EP’s emo-tinged songwriting is reflective of her life experiences – an eating disorder, toxic relationship and neglected friendships – and her core identity. “I do gravitate towards heavier, darker sounds, because I’m a slightly gloomy individual.”
